verse.verse_1: By oath of the sun and its light
verse.verse_2: And by oath of the moon when it follows the sun
verse.verse_3: And by oath of the day when it reveals it
verse.verse_4: And by oath of the night when it hides it
verse.verse_5: And by oath of the heaven and by oath of Him Who made it.
verse.verse_6: And by oath of the earth and by oath of Him Who spread it.
verse.verse_7: And by oath of the soul and by oath of Him Who made it proper.
verse.verse_8: And inspired in it the knowledge of its sins and its piety.
verse.verse_9: Indeed successful is the one who made it pure.
verse.verse_10: And indeed failed is the one who covered it in sin.
verse.verse_11: The tribe of Thamud denied with rebellion.
verse.verse_12: When the most wicked among them stood up in defiance.
verse.verse_13: So the Noble Messenger of Allah said to them, “Stay away from the she camel of Allah, and from its turn to drink.”
verse.verse_14: In response they belied him, and hamstrung the she camel – so Allah put ruin over them because of their sins and flattened their dwellings.
verse.verse_15: And He does not fear its coming behind (to take vengeance).
